name: Ruppichteroth (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of white with a red banner head with a wavy lower edge bearing the inscription mons præclare, charged below with the red Maltese cross and chain of the municipal arms of Ruppichteroth.
history: Municipal flag of Ruppichteroth; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: red banner head with wavy lower edge
Maltese cross with a chain from the municipal arms
